The Raptors defeated the Clippers, 125-118 tonight in LA. Immanuel Quickley finished with a team-high 27 points along with 4 rebounds and 2 assists for the Raptors, while RJ Barrett tallied 26 points, 6 rebounds and 3 assists in the game. Kobe Sanders recorded 26 points, 5 three pointers and 4 rebounds. The Raptors improve their record to 4-3 with the win, while the Clippers fall to 1-6 for the season.
